text:
I'm sorry for the hassle. Unfortunately, refunds can only go to the original payment method, so I can't send it to a different card. In most cases your bank passes the refund on to your replacement card automatically, and card refunds typically take 5-10 business days once issued (3-5 business days for digital wallets).

If you'd rather not wait on that, you can take the refund as Leafy store credit instead, which is issued instantly and never expires. Would you like to go that route, or should I escalate to a Support Lead to look at your situation?
